nonClaims: The closure and the main proof are NOT in this unit. scripts/qc/roadmap-unit-closure.mjs and scripts/qc/roadmap-main-proof.mjs, their two package.json script lines and their fourteen pin cases are the successor U17b, staged at .sisyphus/roadmap-completion-20260912/u17b-staging/. Nothing U17 ships asserts them, and the review, merge, mainProof and tick receipts the loop needs still cannot be generated from main after U17 lands.

Those two files were gated and mutant-tested in this lane before the split (pin 21/21, tsc 0, oxfmt clean, lint:units 100/100, validator PASSED, mutants M1/M2/M4 killed and restored), but they are NOT proven on the head U17 ships. U17b must re-take every gate on its own baseline.

The real proof ladder was never run in this lane: no build, no Playwright, no jest ladder on a merge commit. The main proof was exercised only through --dry-run and its three refusals, all of which now live in U17b.
U13's preserve-run-logs module still has no caller in the repository. Its caller is in the closure and moves with it; until U17b lands the parent runs that CLI by hand before each worktree removal.
The shared library ships whole, so sha256 and lastLine (14 code lines) have no consumer in what U17 ships. lastLine is pinned directly; sha256 is not called by any shipped code path.

The fold and the park have never produced a receipt that the ledger carries. They reproduce the shapes already on main - asserted key by key against U14's entries - but only the parent adopting them for the next unit's fold proves them live.

The six shared-library cases were written at the split, after the library existed, so they are green-first rather than red-first; mutant M6 is what gives them teeth. The red-first claim for this unit covers the fold and the park.
The validator run inside the pin operates on a copy of the ledger plus a fabricated unit, so 'ROADMAP VALIDATION PASSED' there is a statement about the copy, not about main.
No commit, push, stash or PR was made by this lane, and the root checkout was never touched.

findingsReportedNotFixed.what: the cap was broken by 621 lines (1121 product against 500). The parent split the unit; the reduced scope is 461 against 500, inside by 39.
findingsReportedNotFixed.residue: the ledger now carries a unit whose behaviour is half of what its entry describes until U17b is planned and landed

findingsReportedNotFixed.what: the closure carries the Lane A reviewer model as a literal ('claude-sonnet (Agent model: sonnet)'), because the charter's flag list named --implementer and no reviewer flag
findingsReportedNotFixed.suggestion: a --reviewer flag defaulting to that string; the validator already refuses a receipt whose reviewer equals its implementer, so the failure mode is loud

findingsReportedNotFixed.status: moved to U17b, written up in the staging README
findingsReportedNotFixed.what: --skip-blob-check ships in the closure and weakens a real check. It is documented as pin-only in the file header and the merge receipt records `blobEqualityCheck: skipped (--skip-blob-check; the jest pin only)` whenever it is used, but nothing prevents a caller from passing it against a real ledger.
findingsReportedNotFixed.suggestion: gate it on an environment variable the pin sets, or refuse it when --ledger-dir is absent

findingsReportedNotFixed.what: roadmap-unit-park accepts two flags the charter did not name, --red-summary and --local-summary. Without them each summary falls back to the lane receipt's own `summary` field and then to a pointer at the receipt file.
findingsReportedNotFixed.why: the charter's park flag list carries no summaries, but u12-park.js wrote both by hand; a fallback that invents prose would have been worse than a flag
findingsReportedNotFixed.suggestion: the parent may drop the two flags if it prefers the fallback always

findingsReportedNotFixed.what: The pin copies the 17 MB ledger directory into a temporary directory under openspec/planning/ (so the copied validate-roadmap.mjs still resolves the real repository root three levels up). The suite removes it in afterAll, but a crashed or killed run leaves it behind, where it would show up in `git status`.
findingsReportedNotFixed.suggestion: a `u17-pin-*` entry in .gitignore, or a beforeAll sweep of stale `u17-pin-*` directories; neither was added because .gitignore is not an owned path of this unit
findingsReportedNotFixed.note: the staged U17b pin creates the same directory, so the successor inherits this

findingsReportedNotFixed.what: The first admission estimate was 719 product lines for all four generators; the delivered figure was 1121. The estimate was 402 lines low, and the largest single miss was roadmap-main-proof (estimated 170, delivered 276). That miss is what forced the split.
findingsReportedNotFixed.suggestion: for the next harness unit, estimate shell-to-JavaScript ports at roughly seven times the shell line count rather than five, and size the unit against the cap before writing the pin

findingsReportedNotFixed.what: The split leaves the shared library carrying two exports (sha256, lastLine; 14 code lines) whose only consumer is staged. They are counted in U17's 461 lines.
findingsReportedNotFixed.suggestion: leave them - trimming makes U17b's restore a three-file change - or move them to U17b if the parent prefers a library with no dead exports
